questions.prompt: What do we learn about a car?
What do we learn about a jet?
What is the big idea of Fast and Slow?
choices: Things can move fast or slow.
Only a car can move fast.
Only a jet moves very fast.
questions.answer: Things can move fast or slow.
questions.rationale: A car can move fast. A jet moves very fast. Is it fast or slow? Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Things can move fast or slow.
